It replays every sample on real 38-step compressions of both members (0 replay mismatches required), treats rows 16..21 as the importance-split prefix (8,192 particles, 256 proposals per row; the row-16 stage is exact with weight 160/2^32) and counts EXACT (zero output difference after step 37) in the window rows 22..37. heuristics.extrapolation: Registered 24-CV panel in Section 8 and Appendix V section support-8. Under deterministic full-cycle ustart (Section 7), linearity of expectation across all 2^32 tables means only the (u, cv)-averaged bound E[X(X-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[X] is required.
heuristics.limitations: Not testable at the acceptance probability; components only. The 24-CV panel was not stratified by the cv0 class, and the marginal class-rate measurements (F7R, MSG_CLS on an independent pool) do not by themselves establish a factorial-moment inequality, so the class-conditioned transfer is declared, not measured.
heuristics.scope: The Bonferroni factor is the constant 1 - 2^-8.5 = 0.99723786413599... per chaining value: E[J(J-1)]/2 <= 2^-8.5 E[J], and with E[J]=NA*ca_lo*q_pf*q3r=2^-65.24 the absolute loss is 2^-73.74. The factor multiplies E[J] once and carries no E[J] inside the correction. The tighter evaluation recorded in Appendix V section support-8 (2^-61.8) is not charged because it needs a bound on E[K(K-1)]/E[K] that the premise does not supply: K = 2^20 with probability about 2^5.99/2^20 and K = 0 otherwise keeps E[K] and gives E[J(J-1)]/E[J] = q3r(2^20-1), far above 2^-61.8 and still below the declared 2^-7.5. An earlier revision wrote 1 - 2^-8.5*E[J]; that is invalid and withdrawn.
heuristics.statement: Group independence within a chaining value (the form of H5-group-independence of the accepted 44870635): good pairs of one chaining value that share no endpoint (a0 or u) are independent trials of the accepted event, each with probability q3r; good pairs sharing an endpoint form a group counted once. Consequence used: for a uniform chaining value and any table, J (accepted good pairs among all claws of the chaining value) has E[J(J-1)] <= 2^-7.5 E[J]. This filing applies the same premise to the kept-CV class ((cv0 >> 24) & 63 == 12): the class conditions only cv[0], the panel below is drawn from uniform chaining values (so about 1/64 of its CVs are in-class), and the transfer of the second-moment bound to the class-conditioned law is part of this declared premise.

(a) Under H1 a kept chaining value has cv[0] uniform in the class and its other words uniform; for the claws of a kept chaining value C1, C2 and G pass at the rates of H1-P1 (they do not read the chaining value), and F7 passes at the class average of the F7 rate over the good-pair law of q, charged at F7R = 0.1205926 and the step-3b cost at the upper bound 0.1206112, the two one-sided 99% bounds of the class rate from the exhaustive-density estimator (per-top-byte F7 density enumerated over all 2^32 words, reproducing |F7| = 287,309,824; the class average over cv[0] computed in closed form per G-conditioned q so only the q distribution is sampled; 3.21e7 X-samples give 0.1206019 +- 0.0000031, and the equal-weight mean over the 256 byte-classes returns 0.066894531 against 0.06689453125); the earlier 2^20-q interval [0.11987, 0.12135] is superseded and not used. restrictions: Target sha256-r38-prefix-v1 exactly: SHA-256 steps 0..37 on every padded block, the standard IV once, FIPS 180-4 padding, feed-forward, all eight digest words. Output: two distinct 128-byte messages M0||M1 and M0||M1' (common first block) with equal digests; step 3b accepts only if A34..A37, E34..E37 match (Lemma 1, Section 1).

Algebraic Carry-Bootstrap u-Compression (u14t4) & Single-Lane Geometry (COV_RES=3, L=1, Appendix ZV.1): cover (P(u) - 8174) mod 8192 < 3 (1,572,864 words), store 1 lane/row x 2^19 rows x 3 bytes + 32 B pad = 1,572,896 B with [u14:14][u_top4:4][0:1][res:4][0:1]. Exact 32-bit recovery from (Y, u14, u_top4) verified on all 499,621 retained entries (0 mismatches).

Split-LUT Bitsliced Front End (Appendix ZV.1): compress SP_S0/SP_S10/SP_K0_LO,HI/SP_K1_LO,HI to 5,376 B (vs 224 KiB) and CTZ16 to CTZ8 (256 B vs 64 KiB), cutting total uniform LUTs from 320 KiB to 19,584 B (< 20,480 B) at exact GBS=236 (+21 conservative ops) and EXTRACT_BS=22 (+2 ops), 0 mismatches.

Deterministic full-cycle ustart (NE=2^32): iterate deterministically over all N_E = 2^32 = 4,294,967,296 epochs ustart in 0..2^32-1, each executing K = 21,997,772,926,617 first blocks (N_CV = N_E*K = 94,479,715,304,654,222,917,632) with zero epoch-mixture gap and zero Lemma T dependency.

Complete all-phases sequential peak memory <= 1,835,008 B (1.75 MiB exact, memory_log2_bytes = 20.80736, Section 10 & Appendix ZV.3-ZV.4): all preprocessing and online phases execute strictly below 1,835,008 B with zero omitted preprocessing memory, verified by 5 standalone zero-libc ELF witnesses (sfs_1m 212,992 B; gmass_1m 741,376 B; fillr2_1m 544,768 B; msample_1m 45,056 B; witness_u14_175m max 1,769,472 B). Organizer scalar = 80.62709.

Declared exploratory assumptions: inherited H1-P1, H2-P1, H2b, H3-P1, H3B, H4a-H4c, strengthened fixed-alignment H7 (E=499,621), H8 (MSG_LO=-0.011821), H9 (MSG_CLS=-0.0225), and exhaustive-density F7 bounds remain explicitly declared exploratory premises (Appendix Y).
